title: Platform Change Lab
purpose: Review a declarative platform change before any live mutation.
scope: Summarize resource actions and identify destructive transitions.
Describe identity, dependencies and recovery prerequisites.
non_goals: No apply, credential changes or real cloud access.
constraints: Treat the supplied plan as synthetic evidence only.
Require explicit target and approval before a future real apply.
acceptance: No secret-like plan values appear in the summary.
